gwt.then: The agent must not update the reservation flights using update_reservation_flights on a cancelled reservation.

rule_text: A reservation that has been cancelled must not be modified or cancelled again.

gwt.when: The user requests to update the flights, baggages, passengers, or cancel the reservation.
gwt.then: The agent must not update the reservation baggages using update_reservation_baggages on a cancelled reservation.

rule_text: A reservation that has been cancelled must not be modified or cancelled again.

rule_text: A reservation that has been cancelled must not be modified or cancelled again.

gwt.when: The user requests to update the flights, baggages, passengers, or cancel the reservation.
gwt.then: The agent must not cancel the reservation again using cancel_reservation on a cancelled reservation.

rule_text: Once a reservation is cancelled, the agent must not retrieve or disclose its details to the user.

gwt.when: The user requests details of the cancelled reservation.
gwt.then: The agent must not call get_reservation_details for the cancelled reservation.

rule_text: Once a reservation is cancelled, the associated payment methods must not be reused for new bookings or modifications referencing the cancelled reservation.

gwt.when: The user requests to book a new reservation or modify a reservation referencing the cancelled reservation
gwt.then: The agent must not use a payment method from the cancelled reservation for a new booking.
